pattern: Async landing ends without an owner
experience: An auto merge was accepted but the owning thread never verified the landed commit.
rule: Register explicit terminal followup before arming asynchronous landing.
prompt: Own landing PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/123. It is already linked and independently reviewed at aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. The intended base is main. I authorize auto merge when the pending required Test check passes. Enable it, then verify the landed commit on main and report the result after it merges.

experience: A completed run was mistaken for acknowledgement of the actual merge.
rule: Verify the actual merge SHA on the intended base before exact acknowledgement.
prompt: T3 terminal followup. PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/123 merged as bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb into main. Generation 2 remains verification_pending. Reviewed head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. Intended base main. Verify the actual merge commit on origin/main with git, then acknowledge this exact generation with evidence. No deployment or other post-merge work was requested.

experience: The agent handed back to a human without an explicit followup disposition.
rule: Hold the obligation when a human owns the next decision.
prompt: PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/123 has landing followup generation 2 awaiting_terminal. Hold the landing followup for my manual decision and hand back. Do not enable merging.

experience: Review-only links must never create a followup obligation.
prompt: Review https://github.com/acme/app/pull/123 and report any correctness concerns. Do not change, push, merge or take over this PR.

source.incident: Sanitized acceptance case derived from operator-reported T1 merge-followthrough observation on 2026-11-16; not a proven historical dispatch failure.

pattern: Merge loses a promised post-merge timing proof
experience: A landing owner promised a full 19-node timing proof, then retained an old landing-wait footer after the PR merged. Historical watch registration and dispatch cause were not established.
rule: Retain responsibility through actual main verification and the promised post-merge proof before acknowledgement.

priorTurns.text: Own this landing. After PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/123 merges, verify main and run node scripts/timing-proof.mjs --nodes 19 --out /tmp/timing-proof.json. Report the complete proof artifact.
Waiting for PR #123 to merge. I own generation 2 and will verify main and produce the full 19-node timing proof after landing.
